title: Stage&Karaoke - Pool - 5min Walk to Broadway
description:
Welcome to The Disco Penthouse! Our condo sleeps 8 comfortably with make-up stations for 7.  You are steps from Broadway, Bridgestone Arena, The Music City Center. All of downtown Nashville is at your doorstep! 

But who needs Broadway when you have a stage in your living room? Grab a mic, turn on your favorite song, get on stage and sing your heart out as the disco ball spins and transforms your living room into your very own private karaoke bar!  

Permit #2018072321

Guest access
Guest access will be via Latch. All details and instructions will be sent over after booking confirmation.
